_why: Where a dimension's NUMBER sits. ONE statement of intent, read by BOTH sides: rt81 checks PlanCanvas.dim_label_xy against it and t50 checks the sheet window's dimLabelXY() against it. The two implementations exist because Ruby draws the number and the window has to know where it is before it can let the user grab it - and two copies of one formula drift. This file is what stops that: neither side can move without one of the suites going red.
_frame: oa runs ALONG the line (start -> end), oc runs ACROSS it, on the normal (-uy, ux). Both in model inches. No oc on the mark means h * 0.8, which is where every dimension sat before 2026-08-19.
